## Decision rule

```text
One Work
  = one complete outcome
  = one short-lived branch
  = one PR (draft immediately)
  = arbitrary commits / phases inside that PR
  = one Merge Queue candidate when ready
  = normally one squash-merged main integration unit
```

| Layer | Role |
| --- | --- |
| **Commits** | Private checkpoints for recovery, attribution, and PR-head CI |
| **PR** | Candidate envelope for the full outcome |
| **Squash on main** | Single production-ready Work unit |

**Rule (Agent-Native Queued Trunk — ADR-20260803):** commits on the branch are checkpoints; what lands on `main` is one complete Work via squash.[[1]](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SylphxAI/skills/main/docs/adr/ADR-20260803-agent-native-queued-trunk.md)

### On the branch / inside the PR
- **Commit freely.** Frequency is unconstrained: 5, 20, or 100 commits (checkpoints, repairs, refactors, retries) are fine.[[1]](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SylphxAI/skills/main/docs/adr/ADR-20260803-agent-native-queued-trunk.md)
- There is **no** requirement to craft “atomic” history for `main` aesthetics or to batch commits for CI economics.[[1]](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SylphxAI/skills/main/docs/adr/ADR-20260803-agent-native-queued-trunk.md)
- Intermediate / incomplete states **stay on the PR** — they must not leave as separate merges.[[2]](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SylphxAI/skills/main/skills/parallel-change-integration-standard/references/full-standard.md)
